d: D Gukesh is back on the biggest stage in chess, but defending his World Championship title will be no easy task. The Indian grandmaster faces Uzbekistan's Javokhir Sindarov in a historic World Chess Championship match between two 20-year-olds. With Sindarov arriving in impressive form and Gukesh looking to put a difficult year behind him, the battle for the world chess crown promises plenty of intrigue. Rupha Ramani looks at what lies ahead for Gukesh and whether he can defend his title.
